question: Find the first name and last name of a customer who visited on the earliest date.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "customers" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "xing" AS "xing", "ming" AS "ming" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "receipts" AS SELECT "receiptnumber" AS "receiptnumber", "date" AS "date", "customerid" AS "customerid" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH receipts_cast AS (
  SELECT
    receiptnumber,
    /* parse DD-Mon-YYYY */
    strptime(date, '%d-%b-%Y') AS visit_dt,
    customerid
  FROM receipts
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND date <> ''
), earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(visit_dt) AS min_dt FROM receipts_cast
), earliest_visits AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM receipts_cast r
  JOIN earliest e ON r.visit_dt = e.min_dt
), cust AS (
  SELECT CAST(id AS BIGINT) AS id_big, xing AS last_name, ming AS first_name
  FROM customers
)
SELECT ev.visit_dt AS earliest_visit_date, c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM earliest_visits ev
JOIN cust c ON ev.customerid = c.id_big
LIMIT 10;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH receipts_cast AS (
  SELECT
    receiptnumber,
    strptime(date, '%d-%b-%Y') AS visit_dt,
    CAST(customerid AS VARCHAR) AS customerid_str
  FROM receipts
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND date <> ''
), earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(visit_dt) AS min_dt FROM receipts_cast
), earliest_visits AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM receipts_cast r
  JOIN earliest e ON r.visit_dt = e.min_dt
)
SELECT ev.visit_dt AS earliest_visit_date,
       c.ming AS first_name,
       c.xing AS last_name
FROM earliest_visits ev
JOIN customers c ON ev.customerid_str = c.id
LIMIT 10;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH receipts_cast AS (
  SELECT
    receiptnumber,
    strptime(date, '%d-%b-%Y') AS visit_dt,
    CAST(customerid AS VARCHAR) AS customerid_str
  FROM receipts
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND date <> ''
), earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(visit_dt) AS min_dt FROM receipts_cast
), earliest_visits AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM receipts_cast r
  JOIN earliest e ON r.visit_dt = e.min_dt
), cust_norm AS (
  SELECT trim(both '"' from trim(id)) AS id_norm,
         ming AS first_name,
         xing AS last_name
  FROM customers
), ev_norm AS (
  SELECT trim(CAST(customerid_str AS VARCHAR)) AS id_norm,
         visit_dt
  FROM earliest_visits
)
SELECT DISTINCT ev.visit_dt AS earliest_visit_date,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name
FROM ev_norm ev
JOIN cust_norm c ON ev.id_norm = c.id_norm
ORDER BY c.first_name, c.last_name
LIMIT 10;
S:
# Join robustly by normalizing IDs and return distinct earliest customer names
query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH receipts_cast AS (
  SELECT
    receiptnumber,
    strptime(date, '%d-%b-%Y') AS visit_dt,
    CAST(customerid AS VARCHAR) AS customerid_str
  FROM receipts
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND date <> ''
), earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(visit_dt) AS min_dt FROM receipts_cast
), earliest_visits AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM receipts_cast r
  JOIN earliest e ON r.visit_dt = e.min_dt
), cust_norm AS (
  SELECT trim(both '"' from trim(id)) AS id_norm,
         ming AS first_name,
         xing AS last_name
  FROM customers
), ev_norm AS (
  SELECT trim(CAST(customerid_str AS VARCHAR)) AS id_norm,
         visit_dt
  FROM earliest_visits
)
SELECT DISTINCT ev.visit_dt AS earliest_visit_date,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name
FROM ev_norm ev
JOIN cust_norm c ON ev.id_norm = c.id_norm
ORDER BY c.first_name, c.last_name
LIMIT 10;
'''

_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, query)
